entries.title: Revelation of John 7:1
segments: And after these things I saw four angels standing on the four corners of the earth, holding the four winds of the earth so that the wind should not blow on the earth, nor on the sea, nor on any tree.

entries.title: Revelation of John 7:2
segments: And I saw another angel ascending from the east, having the seal of the living God. And he cried with a loud voice to the four angels, to whom it was given to hurt the earth and the sea,

entries.title: Revelation of John 7:3
segments: saying, Do not hurt the earth or the sea or the trees until we have sealed the servants of our God in their foreheads.

entries.title: Revelation of John 7:4
segments: And I heard the number of those who were sealed, one hundred [and] forty-four thousands, having been sealed out of every tribe of the sons of Israel.

entries.title: Revelation of John 7:5
segments: Out of the tribe of Judah, twelve thousand were sealed. Out of the tribe of Reuben, twelve thousand were sealed. Out of the tribe of Gad, twelve thousand had been sealed.

entries.title: Revelation of John 7:6
segments: Out of the tribe of Asher, twelve thousand had been sealed. Out of the tribe of Naphtali, twelve thousand had been sealed. Out of the tribe of Manasseh, twelve thousand had been sealed.

entries.title: Revelation of John 7:7
segments: Out of the tribe of Simeon, twelve thousand had been sealed. Out of the tribe of Levi, twelve thousand had been sealed. Out of the tribe of Issachar, twelve thousand had been sealed.

entries.title: Revelation of John 7:8
segments: Out of the tribe of Zebulun, twelve thousand had been sealed. Out of the tribe of Joseph, twelve thousand had been sealed. Out of the tribe of Benjamin, twelve thousand had been sealed.

entries.title: Revelation of John 7:9
segments: After these things I looked, and lo, a great multitude, which no man could number, out of all nations and kindreds and people and tongues, stood before the throne and before the Lamb, clothed with white robes, with palms in their hands.

entries.title: Revelation of John 7:10
segments: And they cried with a loud voice, saying, Salvation to our God sitting on the throne, and to the Lamb.

entries.title: Revelation of John 7:11
segments: And all the angels stood around the throne, and the elders, and the four living creatures, and they fell before the throne on their faces and worshiped God,

entries.title: Revelation of John 7:12
segments: saying, Amen! Blessing and glory and wisdom and thanksgiving and honor and power and might [be] to our God forever and ever. Amen.

entries.title: Revelation of John 7:13
segments: And one of the elders answered, saying to me, Who are these who are arrayed in white robes, and from where do they come?

entries.title: Revelation of John 7:14
segments: And I said to him, Sir, you know. And he said to me, These are the ones who came out of great tribulation and have washed their robes, and have whitened them in the blood of the Lamb.

entries.title: Revelation of John 7:15
segments: Therefore they are before the throne of God, and they serve Him day and night in His temple. And He sitting on the throne will dwell among them.

entries.title: Revelation of John 7:16
segments: They will not hunger any more, nor thirst any more, nor will the sun light on them, nor any heat.

entries.title: Revelation of John 7:17
segments: For the Lamb who is in the midst of the throne will feed them and will lead them to [the] fountains of living waters. And God will wipe away all tears from their eyes.
